name: Craftsman's Writ: Dark Leather Tunic
summary: A faded, transferable writ requests a Dark Leather Tunic and gives details for delivery and payment. You need the writ to complete the exchange.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: A customer’s faded note asks you for one Dark Leather Tunic. It includes where to deliver the garment and how payment is arranged. The writ can pass from hand to hand, but you need to possess it when completing the transaction.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The customer requests one Dark Leather Tunic.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the tunic?
faq.answer: The writ gives a delivery location, marked on your map.

faq.q: Do I need to keep the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. You need the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.

faq.q: Can I pass the writ to someone else?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.
The note includes information about payment.
